main.description: One turn of the recruiting agent. Served by the AppView and requires service auth (lxm = this NSID). The response streams as server-sent events: turn {conversationId}, text {delta}, tool_call {id, name, arguments}, tool_result {id, name, summary, uris}, final {text, citations, dropped}, done {steps, tokens}, error {message}. The agent reads public records only, drafts text only, and never writes to a repo.

conversationId.description: Continue a conversation. Conversations live in AppView memory for 30 minutes and belong to the DID that started them.
